withdrawn_native_edits.reason: No false native current claim established; preserve existing owner tasks. Correct derived inventory only.

preservation_contract.read_before_write: Fresh-read all local/global identity, status and priority guards plus complete target CellData. If any guard fails or target is not a plain string, stop and remap/review. Preserve the full fresh target snapshot privately; never export raw snapshots or private attachment identifiers.
preservation_contract.idempotency: If exact new_prefix already occurs in target, treat it as already applied and do not duplicate it. Otherwise prefix new_prefix + history_separator before the complete current string.
preservation_contract.metadata: Only update userEnteredValue.stringValue and, where existing rich-text runs exist, textFormatRuns. Preserve notes, cell formatting, validation, hyperlinks and every other field. A userEnteredValue replacement erases existing runs unless they are restored explicitly.
preservation_contract.rich_text: For existing runs, insert an empty-format run at UTF-16 index 0, then copy every old run unchanged except startIndex becomes oldStartIndex (default 0) + UTF-16 length(new_prefix + history_separator). Keep the old boundary run even if empty. Do not remove old link formats. Re-read if a cell-level link or unexpected metadata requires a different preservation method.
preservation_contract.field_masks: Per-cell updateCells with fields userEnteredValue for no-run targets, or userEnteredValue,textFormatRuns for run-bearing targets. Do not write a rectangular range containing unmodified cells.
preservation_contract.status_and_counts: No status, priority, score, proof-state or count fields are write targets. Retain F021 OPEN53, C02 OPEN52, M-TREE-WITNESS OPEN42, bounded TW477 COMPLETE15, Q04 complete and native 68 closed / 259 open.
preservation_contract.scope: C02 additions to NEW-05/Q05/TH-05 are dependency-only and do not equate their full theorems. F021 generic mechanism is classical; chirp-specific gaps remain. Tree body reinspection limitation does not reverse its recorded earlier recovery. Auxiliary C02 author checks are not independently accepted.
preservation_contract.post_write: Independent fresh readback must establish exact prefix plus full original string suffix, shifted old runs, unchanged notes/format/validation, all identity/status/priority guards and unchanged native counts before declaring applied.
